FULL TEXT:
DISTRICT CLIMATE CHANGE MISSION (DCCM), ERODE
RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement of one Technical
Assistant on purely contractual basis for the District Climate Change Mission (DCCM),
Erode District, as per the guidelines issued by the Department of Environment and Climate
Change, Government of Tamil Nadu.
1. Position Details
• Post: Technical Assistant – 01 No.
• Nature of Engagement: Contract Basis
• Consolidated Remuneration: ₹22,000/- per month
• Period of Engagement: 19 months, as per Government sanction
• Place of Work: District Collector Office and District Forest Office
• Travel: Official travel connected with Department of Environment and Climate
Change activities, as per applicable Government norms.
2. Educational Qualification
The candidate should possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences,
Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar relevant
disciplines from a recognised University/Institution.
The candidate should possess basic type writing skills in both Tamil and English.
3. Eligibility Conditions
• The Candidate should be a Resident of Erode District
• The candidate should not have completed 40 years of age as on 01.10.2026
4.Experience and Skills
• Candidates having at least one year of relevant work experience preferably in a Government
Department / Government Office may be given first preference.
• Experience in Data Entry, compilation, tabulation, office documentation and Data
Management.
• Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation.
• Ability to prepare official reports, letters, and PowerPoint presentations.
• Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS Powerpoint.
4. Key Responsibilities
• Coordination and synergy among line departments for environmental protection and
climate action.
• Coordination and Documentation of DCCM activities and capacity-building programmes.
• Documentation of successful climate adaptation and mitigation initiatives.
• Acting as a link between the Department of Environment and Climate Change at State
level and the DCCM at district level.
• Organising DCCM meetings once every two months and preparation/submission of
Minutes of Meeting.
• Reviewing innovations and existing schemes relating to Environment and Climate
Change.
• Planning upcoming activities and stakeholder engagements.
• Assisting in organising District Level Climate Resilient Capacity Building Workshops.
• Preparation and maintenance of files, reports, photographs, videography, expenditure
statements and other documentation relating to DCCM Schemes and activities.
• Perform Any other duties assigned in connection with the activities of the District Climate
Change Mission.
These responsibilities are aligned with the Technical Assistant Role specified in DCCM
Guidelines.
5. Selection Process
Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and
will be called for In-Person Interview and Typing Test. A waiting list of 2–3 candidates will
also be maintained as per the DCCM Guidelines.
6. Submission of Application
Eligible candidates may submit their application along with self-attested copies of
Resume/CV, aadhar, certificates relating to educational qualification, work experience (if any),
typing qualification, and other relevant documents by,
E-mail: dmuerd@gmail.com
Email Subject: Application for Technical Assisstant, District Climate Change Mission,
Erode
In Person To:
District Forest Officer,
Roja Nagar,
Periyasemur,
Erode- 638004.
7. Last Date
Last date for receipt of applications: 29.10.2026.
8. General Conditions
1. The engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right for regular
appointment under the Government.
2. The selected candidate shall comply with the terms and conditions prescribed by the
Department of Environment and Climate Change.
3. The selected candidate shall maintain regular attendance and perform duties assigned
by the District Climate Change Mission.
4. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the typing test/interview.
5. District Climate Change Mission reserves the right to shortlist candidates, modify the
schedule or cancel the recruitment process, subject to the applicable Government
guidelines.
6. Candidates shall provide a valid mobile number and e-mail ID for communication
regarding the selection process.
7. The decision of the competent authority regarding selection shall be final.
